description: This source file defines the ObjectUploader class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically handling the upload process to S3, including multipart upload logic.

classes.name: ObjectUploader
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the upload of objects to Amazon S3, supporting both simple and multipart uploads.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the uploader with necessary parameters such as client, bucket, key, body, etc.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Creates and returns a promise that performs the upload, choosing multipart or regular based on the size.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Performs the upload operation synchronously, waiting for the promise to resolve.

methods.name: requiresMultipart
methods.description: Determines if the upload should be multipart based on body size and modifies the body stream accordingly.
